olga_sales: New prospect WellnessTrust (national payer) posted a presales pack. Ask: SAML (Okta+Azure), SCIM provisioning (200k objects), delegated provisioning across regional subdomains, RBAC mapping (dynamic role attrs), SCIM over mTLS preferred, audit log immutability 10 years, and option for private on-prem air-gap. They want a 5-week POC + firm price. Any immediate blockers?
kevin_se: Feasible but several things to call out: 1) SCIM mTLS requires Private deployment; hosted only token-based SCIM. 2) 200k initial objects -> bulk import recommended; deltas via change-token or webhook. We support webhook events for SCIM change notifications in Private. 3) Delegated provisioning across subdomains requires domain-proof per subdomain (DNS TXT preferred) or a signed SAML assertion flow.
isabel_infosec: Compliance: HIPAA + state-specific regs. BAA required before any PHI. Ten-year log retention is long; we can support via customer S3 with Object Lock (WORM) but legal needs to confirm jurisdictional hold rules. We support BYOK/KMS in Private; keys do not leave customer KMS. Also need SOC2 and recent pen test report.
kevin_se: For RBAC dynamic attributes we'll accept role assignment via SCIM extension attribute (e.g., urn:custom:roles) or map group claims from SAML. Ask them for a sample CSV or JSON mapping file.
olga_sales: They asked whether webhooks can be delivered over private connectors (no public internet).
kevin_se: Yes, webhooks can be routed through the VPC connector or delivered to a customer endpoint over peered network, but that pushes this to Private and may require a connector appliance install window (3-5 business days).
a na_legal: Draft language for questionnaire about keys and logs: "Customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments. Keys remain under customer control; Redwood stores only envelope keys. Audit logs can be exported to customer S3 or forwarded to customer SIEM; immutability can be implemented via S3 Object Lock or customer-managed WORM storage." Approve?
isabel_infosec: Approve but add: "No PHI will be written to default hosted logs prior to BAA execution"
infra-bot: ticket RED-40007 created for WellnessTrust POC (owner: kevin_se) - https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-40007
olga_sales: Cost ask: can you ballpark a 5-week Private POC with connector + one on-site eng day?
kevin_se: Ballpark: Private staging & connector engineering $30k, connector install & runbook $10k, eng on-site day $4k -> total ~$44k. If they require air-gapped on-prem inference nodes add ~$50k. Final quote after finance review.
olga_sales: I'll request SAML metadata, SCIM mTLS certs, sample role mapping, and confirmation on webhook delivery method. Will post replies here. :thumbsup:
